message.teleport.blocked: Teleporting is disabled on this server
message.teleport.turned_off: Teleporting is turned off in the teleport settings
options.teleport.title: teleport Settings
options.teleport.mode.disabled.descripti: The mod is turned off everywhere: /tp @c and Click TP do not move you.
options.teleport.mode.oneconfig.descript: The settings are managed in OneConfig. There, the mod is off until you turn it on with its toggle, and then works in singleplayer and on every server; use OneConfig profiles to change that for a server. The settings below show what OneConfig applies and cannot be changed here.
options.teleport.mode.oneconfig.missing: OneConfig mode is selected, but OneConfig is not installed, so the settings below apply.
options.teleport.click_tp.description: Right-clicking a block teleports you to it on your client. Sneak to use blocks and items normally. The Toggle Click TP key switches the same setting. It only works while the mod is on and allowed on the server.
options.teleport.click_tp_reach.descript: How far away, in blocks, Click TP finds the block you look at.
options.teleport.click_tp_preview.descri: Shows a translucent copy of you where Click TP would put you.
options.teleport.multiplayer_mode.descri: Client teleports may be set back by the server, and servers with anti-cheat may kick or ban you for them. This mod does not try to bypass any anti-cheat.
options.teleport.multiplayer_mode.whitel: Teleports only on servers in the server list.
options.teleport.multiplayer_mode.blackl: Teleports on all servers except those in the server list.
options.teleport.edit_servers.descriptio: Edit the addresses used by the whitelist and blacklist modes.
options.teleport.servers.title: Server List
teleport.command.get.spectator: %s is not loaded on your client. As a spectator, you can reach it with the spectator teleport.
teleport.command.spectator: Asked the server to teleport you to %s (spectator teleport)
teleport.command.selector_unsupported: This selector cannot be evaluated on the client
teleport.command.not_loaded: %s is not loaded on your client, and nothing else tells where it is
teleport.command.not_loaded.chunk: %s is not loaded on your client. The locator bar only shows that it is in chunk %s, %s (X %s to %s, Z %s to %s)
teleport.command.not_loaded.direction: %s is not loaded on your client. The locator bar only shows its direction: yaw %s (%s)
teleport.command.other_dimension: That location is in %s. Client teleports cannot change dimension
teleport.command.no_back: No previous position in this dimension
teleport.command.no_home: No home is set. Use /tp @c sethome
teleport.command.no_temp: No temp location is set. Use /tp @c settemp
teleport.command.no_spawn: Your respawn point is not known yet
teleport.command.no_worldspawn: The world spawn is not known
teleport.command.not_in_world: You are not in a world
